minimal_human_task.question: 现有 Evidence 是否已经足够让机器完成该任务？

options.B: 不足，但可以通过已有/可获得 Evidence 解决 → FALSE_G5 (G1-G4)
options.C: Evidence 已经充分，但仍需要语义判断 → TRUE_G5 candidate

minimal_human_task.design_principle: Asks about EVIDENCE SUFFICIENCY, not SEMANTIC ANSWER → Boundary Signal, not Answer Learning

final_questions.Q1_which_cases: Tier 1: 18 cases (12 Tier 1a CE2-like + 6 Tier 1b same-case-type)
final_questions.Q2_why: Historical G5 pattern (ambiguous_fragment+Type_B_negative, dep=True) + 12 CE2-like mixed configs + multi-field combination
final_questions.Q3_reduce_human: Tier screening 192→18 (90.6%), minimal task (A/B/C/D), Phase 2 conditional, Tier 3/4 excluded
final_questions.Q4_selection_bias: Acknowledged: case_type, definitive, domain biases. Mitigated by Tier 2, negative examples, transparent reporting
final_questions.Q5_minimal_protocol: ONE question per case (A/B/C/D), 18-33 tasks, ~15 minutes total, no YES/NO, no rules, no system modification
final_questions.Q6_how_many_g5_needed: Minimum 1, Target 3, Ideal 6. No statistical threshold (pattern-based only). If 0: valid finding (G5 may be UNCERTAIN-specific)
final_questions.Q7_worth_it: SUPPORTED — low cost (18 tasks, ~15 min), high potential (2-6 G5), no system risk, no alternative path
final_questions.Q8_next_phase_only_human_validation: YES — NEXT_GATE = NEW_G5_HUMAN_VALIDATION. Execute protocol, classify, re-test Signal. No system development.
